name: @argszero/cordis-plugin-goal-progress-guard
description: Progress judgement for dsh autonomous goal rounds: pause an active goal while its background jobs or delegated subagents are still running (resume when the last one drains), and stop a goal whose rounds have stopped producing tool calls. The harness driver stops a goal only at its own `maxGoalRounds`, and `idle` there means only "no turn is running" — so an agent waiting on a job or a child is indistinguishable from one that is finished, and must keep talking to fill the rounds. Source: discussion #7198 (with #1831 / #4664) and #9607. It programs only against documented service shapes and imports no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` package at runtime; its only runtime dependency is `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` plus the `@deepseek-ai/cordis` peer.
